title: Ultenic U18 PowerPro Cordless Vacuum Review: 55kPa Suction & 80-Min Runtime
metaDescription: In-depth Ultenic U18 PowerPro review: 600W motor, 55kPa high suction power, GreenEye LED dust detection, bendable wand, self-standing design, and comparison.
author: ByteBuy Team

sections.content: Finding a high-performance cordless stick vacuum cleaner with ultra-high suction power doesn't always require spending Dyson-level money. The Ultenic U18 PowerPro combines a massive 600W brushless motor delivering up to 55kPa suction with an extended 80-minute battery runtime. Equipped with a 180-degree bendable tube, self-standing capability, anti-tangle V-shaped brush, and GreenEye LED illuminate technology, this vacuum cleaner targets deep-cleaning tasks across hard floors, rugs, and furniture with minimal effort.

items.label: Brush Technology
items.value: Anti-Tangle V-Shaped Roller with GreenEye LED

pros: Exceptional 55kPa suction power driven by a 600W brushless motor
Up to 80 minutes of continuous runtime on a single charge
180° flexible bendable wand easily reaches under low couches and furniture without bending over
GreenEye LED technology reveals microscopic dust particles invisible under normal light
Freestanding self-standing design allows convenient pauses during cleaning sessions
6-stage HEPA filtration traps up to 99.99% of micro-particles and allergens
Quiet operation around 62dB compared to conventional heavy-duty stick vacuums
cons: Takes around 4–5 hours for a full battery recharge
Slightly heavier handheld motor weight (3.34 kg) compared to entry-level lightweight stick vacuums
Maximum 80-minute runtime is achieved in Floor Mode; Turbo mode reduces runtime to ~25–35 minutes

items.question: Is the Ultenic U18 PowerPro good for households with pets?
items.answer: Yes, it is specifically designed with an anti-tangle V-shaped roller brush roll that prevents pet hair from wrapping around the brush head, combined with 55kPa suction power to easily extract hair embedded in carpets and upholstery.

items.question: How does the GreenEye LED light help during cleaning?
items.answer: The GreenEye technology projects a precise green beam on hard floors. Green light creates higher contrast than standard white LEDs, highlighting fine dust, sand, and pet dander that are otherwise invisible to the naked eye.

items.question: Can I replace or swap the battery?
items.answer: Yes, the battery pack is fully detachable. You can remove it to charge separately or purchase an additional battery pack to extend your cleaning sessions indefinitely.

items.question: How often should I clean or replace the HEPA filter?
items.answer: The 6-stage filtration system uses washable filter components. We recommend washing the pre-filter and HEPA filter with cold water once a month and letting them air dry completely for 24 hours before reassembling.

sections.content: The Ultenic U18 PowerPro Cordless Vacuum Cleaner delivers an exceptional ratio of suction power to price. With its standout 55kPa suction, 80-minute max runtime, GreenEye dust detection, and flexible bendable wand, it eliminates the major pain points of affordable stick vacuums. It is an ideal pick for pet owners, large apartments, and multi-floor houses looking for heavy-duty cleaning efficiency on a budget.
